flows:
Navigate to https://revoke.cash then Do not connect a wallet or sign anything.
Never press 'Revoke', 'Connect Wallet', or any button that moves funds or changes approvals.
On revoke.cash, type the public address 'vitalik.eth' into the address search box at the top of the page and press Enter to open its approvals page without connecting a wallet.
In the approvals table, note the spender address or name shown in the 'Approved Spender' column of the first row.
Get the spender address or name shown in the 'Approved Spender' column of the first row and save as {{approved_spender}}.
Type {{approved_spender}} into the search or filter box above the approvals table.
Assert that the approvals table shows at least one row and that every visible row lists {{approved_spender}} in the 'Approved Spender' column.

summary:
Looked up the public address vitalik.eth on revoke.cash without connecting a wallet.
Identified the first approval’s approved spender as Uniswap.
Filtered the approvals table for Uniswap; 25 matching approval rows were shown, and all visible rows listed Uniswap as the approved spender.
No wallet was connected and no approval or funds-changing action was taken.
